identity: Mono-black Station midrange built around Entropic Battlecruiser. The deck deploys unusually mana-efficient charge-counter batteries — Monoist Sentry is a 4-power Defender for {B} whose only job is to be tapped, Sunset Saboteur is another 4 power for {1}{B}, and Bygone Colossus warps in for {3} as a 9-power one-shot battery — to push the Battlecruiser past its 8+ threshold. At 8+ it is a 3/10 flying deathtouch attacker whose attack trigger forces a discard, which its own 1+ ability converts into 3 life loss: 6 damage per swing from a single permanent. Virus Beetle and Temporal Intervention supply four more discard triggers worth 3 life each while it is still at 1+, and Sunset Saboteur's Ward adds a fifth that costs no card. Because the payoff is capped at one copy, the same battery package also crosses the thresholds of Susurian Dirgecraft (7+), Fell Gravship (8+) and Wurmwall Sweeper (4+), and Scrounge for Eternity returns the Battlecruiser from the graveyard to the battlefield if it is answered.

sideboard.name: Dauntless Scrapbot
sideboard.oracle_text: When this creature enters, exile each opponent's graveyard. Create a Lander token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.")
sideboard.when_to_board: vs any deck using its graveyard (31 cube cards / 12.5% density). 'When this creature enters, exile each opponent's graveyard. Create a Lander token.' One-sided, so unlike symmetric hate it does not cost this deck its own Scrounge for Eternity / Fell Gravship rebuy. Still a 3-power Station battery.

sideboard.name: Thaumaton Torpedo
sideboard.oracle_text: {6}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Destroy target nonland permanent. This ability costs {3} less to activate if you attacked with a Spacecraft this turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs enchantments (16 cube cards) and the 52 non-Spacecraft artifacts, which the mainboard cannot touch at all. '{6}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Destroy target nonland permanent. This ability costs {3} less to activate if you attacked with a Spacecraft this turn.' The discount is live only from the threshold turn onward.

sideboard.name: Embrace Oblivion
sideboard.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice an artifact or creature.
Destroy target creature or Spacecraft.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs decks with a Spacecraft top-end. 'As an additional cost, sacrifice an artifact or creature. Destroy target creature or Spacecraft.' The natural fodder is a spent battery: a Monoist Sentry or warped Bygone Colossus that has already deposited its permanent counters has no further use.

sideboard.name: Faller's Faithful
sideboard.oracle_text: When this creature enters, destroy up to one other target creature. If that creature wasn't dealt damage this turn, its controller draws two cards.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs creature decks. 'When this creature enters, destroy up to one other target creature.' Replaces Vote Out, whose Convoke taps the same creatures Station needs. This leaves a 3-power battery behind instead of consuming one.

sideboard.name: Gravkill
sideboard.when_to_board: second copy vs decks whose plan is one big creature or Spacecraft. 'Exile target creature or Spacecraft.' — exile beats the cube's 31 graveyard-recursion cards.

sideboard.name: Tezzeret, Cruel Captain
sideboard.oracle_text:
Whenever an artifact you control enters, put a loyalty counter on Tezzeret.
0: Untap target artifact or creature. If it's an artifact creature, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
−3: Search your library for an artifact card with mana value 1 or less, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
−7: You get an emblem with "At the beginning of combat on your turn, put three +1/+1 counters on target artifact you control. If it's not a creature, it becomes a 0/0 Robot artifact creature."
sideboard.when_to_board: vs attrition decks past turn 8. '0: Untap target artifact or creature' untaps a Station battery every turn, doubling counters per turn cycle; 'Whenever an artifact you control enters, put a loyalty counter on Tezzeret' is live off 15 of 22 mainboard nonland cards. Its -3 fetches 'an artifact card with mana value 1 or less', which finds Monoist Sentry (the best battery in the pool) but not the MV-4 payoff.

sideboard.name: Chrome Companion
sideboard.oracle_text:
Whenever this creature becomes tapped, you gain 1 life.
{2}, {T}: Put target card from a graveyard on the bottom of its owner's library.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs fast clocks and recursion. '{2}, {T}: Put target card from a graveyard on the bottom of its owner's library' is repeatable, targeted hate that does not exile your own yard. 'Whenever this creature becomes tapped, you gain 1 life' triggers off Station itself.

identity_es: Midrange de Station mono negro construido alrededor de Entropic Battlecruiser. El mazo despliega baterías de contadores de carga inusualmente eficientes en maná — Monoist Sentry es un Defensor de 4 de fuerza por {B} cuyo único trabajo es estar girado, Sunset Saboteur son otros 4 de fuerza por {1}{B}, y Bygone Colossus entra con warp por {3} como batería de un solo uso de 9 de fuerza — para empujar a la Battlecruiser más allá de su umbral de 8+. A 8+ es una atacante 3/10 voladora con toque mortal cuyo disparo de ataque fuerza un descarte, que su propia habilidad de 1+ convierte en 3 de pérdida de vida: 6 de daño por golpe desde un único permanente. Virus Beetle y Temporal Intervention aportan otros cuatro disparos de descarte que valen 3 vidas cada uno mientras sigue a 1+, y el Ward de Sunset Saboteur añade un quinto que no cuesta carta. Como la recompensa está limitada a una copia, ese mismo paquete de baterías cruza también los umbrales de Susurian Dirgecraft (7+), Fell Gravship (8+) y Wurmwall Sweeper (4+), y Scrounge for Eternity devuelve la Battlecruiser del cementerio al campo de batalla si responden a ella.
